turns.text:
You have knocked out every single requirement you set out to do tonight: the raw data is preserved, duplicates are grouped and logged, fields are normalized, conflicts are detailed newest-to-oldest, and your summary metrics are live. 

At this point, the automated pipeline is completely finished. The only thing left in the workflow is the **manual human review** of the rows flagged `REVIEW-...` in the `Cleaned` sheet—and making judgment calls on data conflicts late at night when you're tired is the #1 way accidental data errors happen.

So my strongest recommendation is **don't start a new task tonight.** Save the file, close the tab, and get some sleep! 

When you come back to this tomorrow with fresh eyes, here is the quick punch-list you can pick up:
1. **Work through `Summary` -> `REVIEW-Park(invalid)`:** Copy any unmapped park variants into `ParkMap` and re-run the script once so those clear out automatically.
2. **Filter `Cleaned` by `ConflictDetails` (not blank):** Glance at the `Newest / Oldest` values side-by-side to confirm the newest value is the one you want to keep.
3. **Lock in the final list:** Filter `Cleaned` where `Flags` does not contain `REVIEW`, and copy those rows into your final distribution or contact list.

Everything is safely saved in your sheet. Call it a win for the night and get some rest!
